title: Two frames, same still life
alt_text: Two small frames show one fixed mug-and-book arrangement, first with generous margins and then cropped closer. The object shapes stay simple and slightly uneven.
caption: In seven minutes, change the frame, not the arrangement.

provenance.creator_or_model: Codex; deterministic SVG paths authored for this course

review_notes: Portrait SVG with labels sized for a 390 px phone viewport; review in the app before release.
